Here’s what the numbers say:

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Distance (Rivermist → Stonebrook) | ≈ 750 km |
| Remaining fuel‑range (your car) | ≈ 560 km |

Your vehicle can comfortably cover roughly 560 km before needing another refuel. Since the trip requires around 750 km, you’re short by about 190 km—roughly one third of your total route length.

---

### Options to consider

| Option | How it helps | Rough cost / effort |
|--------|--------------|---------------------|
| **Refuel now** | Adds extra range immediately. If you top off at least 25–30% of the tank (~12–15 gal), you'll gain enough fuel to finish the trip safely. | $30–$45 depending on local gas prices |
| **Add a spare fuel container** | Some vehicles allow carrying a portable fuel container (e.g., a 5‑gal bottle). You’d still need to plan where to refill later. | Minimal upfront cost ($10–$20) |

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Distance (Rivermist → Stonebrook) | ≈ 750 km |
| Remaining fuel‑range (your car) | ≈ 560 km |

Your vehicle can comfortably cover roughly 560 km before needing another refuel. Since the trip requires around 750 km, you’re short by about 190 km—roughly one third of your total route length.

---

### Options to consider

| Option | How it helps | Rough cost / effort |
|--------|--------------|---------------------|
| **Refuel now** | Adds extra range immediately. If you top off at least 25–30% of the tank (~12–15 gal), you'll gain enough fuel to finish the trip safely. | $30–$45 depending on local gas prices |
| **Add a spare fuel container** | Some vehicles allow carrying a portable fuel container (e.g., a 5‑gal bottle). You’d still need to plan where to refill later. | Minimal upfront cost ($10–$20) |
| **Use a roadside assistance service** | Many insurance plans include emergency fueling. Call ahead to confirm coverage. | Usually free under policy terms |
| **Split the trip into stages** | Stop at a town halfway through (≈ 375 km mark) to refuel. That way you only need half a tank worth of extra fuel. | Same as normal refueling costs |

If you decide to refuel right away, let me know the approximate amount you'd like to add (in gallons or liters), and I can help you locate the nearest station or even place a quick order for delivery.", refusal=None, role='assistant', annotations=None, audio=None, function_call=None, tool_calls=[], reasoning='Distance ~750 km. ---

| Option | How it helps | Rough cost / effort |
|--------|--------------|---------------------|
| **Refuel now** | Adds extra range immediately. If you top off at least 25–30% of the tank (~12–15 gal), you'll gain enough fuel to finish the trip safely. | $30–$45 depending on local gas prices |
| **Add a spare fuel container** | Some vehicles allow carrying a portable fuel container (e.g., a 5‑gal bottle). You’d still need to plan where to refill later. | Minimal upfront cost ($10–$20) |
| **Use a roadside assistance service** | Many insurance plans include emergency fueling. Call ahead to confirm coverage. | Usually free under policy terms |
| **Split the trip into stages** | Stop at a town halfway through (≈ 375 km mark) to refuel. That way you only need half a tank worth of extra fuel. | Same as normal refueling costs |

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Distance (Rivermist → Stonebrook) | ≈ 750 km |
| Remaining fuel‑range (your car) | ≈ 560 km |

Your vehicle can comfortably cover roughly 560 km before needing another refuel. Since the trip requires around 750 km, you’re short by about 190 km—roughly one third of your total route length.

---

### Options to consider

| Option | How it helps | Rough cost / effort |
|--------|--------------|---------------------|
| **Refuel now** | Adds extra range immediately. If you top off at least 25–30% of the tank (~12–15 gal), you'll gain enough fuel to finish the trip safely. | $30–$45 depending on local gas prices |
| **Add a spare fuel container** | Some vehicles allow carrying a portable fuel container (e.g., a 5‑gal bottle). You’d still need to plan where to refill later. | Minimal upfront cost ($10–$20) |
| **Use a roadside assistance service** | Many insurance plans include emergency fueling. Call ahead to confirm coverage. | Usually free under policy terms |
| **Split the trip into stages** | Stop at a town halfway through (≈ 375 km mark) to refuel. That way you only need half a tank worth of extra fuel. | Same as normal refueling costs |

If you decide to refuel right away, let me know the approximate amount you'd like to add (in gallons or liters), and I can help you locate the nearest station or even place a quick order for delivery.", refusal=None, role='assistant', annotations=None, audio=None, function_call=None, tool_calls=[], reasoning='Distance ~750 km. | Remaining fuel‑range (your car) | ≈ 560 km |

Your vehicle can comfortably cover roughly 560 km before needing another refuel. Since the trip requires around 750 km, you’re short by about 190 km—roughly one third of your total route length.

---

### Options to consider

| Option | How it helps | Rough cost / effort |
|--------|--------------|---------------------|
| **Refuel now** | Adds extra range immediately. If you top off at least 25–30% of the tank (~12–15 gal), you'll gain enough fuel to finish the trip safely. | $30–$45 depending on local gas prices |
| **Add a spare fuel container** | Some vehicles allow carrying a portable fuel container (e.g., a 5‑gal bottle). You’d still need to plan where to refill later. | Minimal upfront cost ($10–$20) |
| **Use a roadside assistance service** | Many insurance plans include emergency fueling. Call ahead to confirm coverage. | Usually free under policy terms |
| **Split the trip into stages** | Stop at a town halfway through (≈ 375 km mark) to refuel. That way you only need half a tank worth of extra fuel. | Same as normal refueling costs |

---

### Options to consider

| Option | How it helps | Rough cost / effort |
|--------|--------------|---------------------|
| **Refuel now** | Adds extra range immediately. If you top off at least 25–30% of the tank (~12–15 gal), you'll gain enough fuel to finish the trip safely. | $30–$45 depending on local gas prices |
| **Add a spare fuel container** | Some vehicles allow carrying a portable fuel container (e.g., a 5‑gal bottle). You’d still need to plan where to refill later. | Minimal upfront cost ($10–$20) |
| **Use a roadside assistance service** | Many insurance plans include emergency fueling. Call ahead to confirm coverage. | Usually free under policy terms |
| **Split the trip into stages** | Stop at a town halfway through (≈ 375 km mark) to refuel. That way you only need half a tank worth of extra fuel. | Same as normal refueling costs |
